name: waterfall_spray
_comment: : waterfall plunge-pool SPRAY/MIST. Anchored at the detected fall's plunge foot by ParticlePass::add_waterfall_spray, which re-shapes origin_extent + spawn_rate + base_velocity from the fall's drop height + channel width. atlas_layer 4 is the render-side foam SENTINEL the particle frag shader reads to draw clean near-white mist (no emissive glow). alpha-blended white-blue so the plume reads as rising spray. wind_response lets the mist drift on the  wind.: motion is render-time, never hashed.
